integrity: Analytic proof with exact symbolic determinant and Lyapunov identities, finite-rational checks and explicit publication-priority qualifications. Independent scientific validation not performed.
scientific_limitations: Exact scalar quadratic gradients, independent Bernoulli erasures and feedback η=1; no assertion for broader objectives, correlated compression or reduced feedback; statement concerns mean-square, not almost-sure, stability.
title: Sharp Bernoulli-erasure stability frontier for maximal-feedback EControl
